test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 17 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some houses are trees.

All flowers are houses.

No vegetable is a flower.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some vegetables are houses is a possibility.

(II) Some flowers are trees is a possibility.

(III) No vegetable is a house.

options.text: Both conclusions II and III follow
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
Given Statements:

Some houses are trees.

All flowers are houses.

No vegetable is a flower.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe4ba95148e8589dd89ea54565a89cc01f953067d2091e34fda86787529f8d78.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some vegetables are houses is a possibility - True (Because, Some houses are not vegetables, but no information given about the remaining part between vegetables and houses, so it can be possible).

II. Some flowers are trees is a possibility - True (Because, No definite relation given between flowers and trees, so it can be possible).

III. No vegetable is a house - False (Because, some vegetables are definitely not houses, but no information given about the remaining part, so it can be possible only).

So, Both conclusions I and II follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
